title: VariantParams
description: Provider-state parameters whose value depends on the running variant — the RFC's 'whenVariant', designed in spec.md §6. Carried in a state's own 'variant-params' member, never wrapped inside a parameter value: a parameter value is user data, so an in-band marker is ambiguous. The provider-state document around this is design 2.5's.

Binding.title: Binding
Binding.description: One state parameter, resolved from the variant's point for one dimension (spec.md §6.4).

name.description: The state parameter this binds. MUST NOT also appear among the state's literal parameters.

dimension.description: A dimension reference: full id, full path, or a trailing run of whole path segments. Resolved by the engine at add-interaction and recorded resolved (spec.md §6.3).

default.description: The value when the dimension is inactive, or takes a point no case names. Required when the dimension is gated (spec.md §6.5). Absent with no matching case means the parameter is absent for that variant — not null.

Case.title: Case
Case.description: The value this parameter takes when the dimension is at this point.
